scope: Six fixed quotactl_fd errno cases on one trusted ordinary child per case inside the owned L1. The ordinary daemon/warden/guest ELF bytes are unchanged, but the syscall-case daemon launch has an additional inherited TEST ONLY seccomp/NNP notification layer. This is NOT an identical production launch environment or physical media EIO/EROFS.
observer: Linux6.8 notification sizes queried and checked against exact fixed UAPI. Wrong architecture/x32 rejected. NEW_LISTENER+TSYNC+TSYNC_ESRCH+WAIT_KILLABLE_RECV; unsupported all-thread setup fails, no per-thread fallback.

Only fixed direct PID1 child, immutable process-start identity, notification thread-group and owned runtime-anchor inode checked. Listener transferred once via bounded private SCM_RIGHTS and closed in the exec child. No tenant-selected PID, FD, syscall, errno, path or project surface.

Default successful observation sends CONTINUE into the actual kernel, never synthetic return0. Selected failures return negative EIO or EROFS, not an emulated successful quota operation. Notification ID validated before response; canceled/stale IDs do not count as injections.

Read-only observer independently reads actual kernel limits/usage and exact durable attempted owner while the selected syscall is awaiting the response. No tracee pointer read or parent quota SET/clear; the ordinary driver alone owns quota changes.

Additional observer layer does not replace the production warden quota deny filter or Firecracker default seccomp. Actual real VM FD, all-thread capability absence/NNP and observer+ordinary filter layering checked in each successful guest.

fixed_cases.selected_call: first reserve Q_SETQUOTA after durable quota_attempted owner
Q_SYNC following reserve SET and readback
Q_SETQUOTA clear after stopped execution and private namespace removal
Q_GETQUOTA after clear SET and Q_SYNC

prepare_failure_checks: Each reserve injection actually delivered once; Create500, no jail/cgroup at injection, durable DESTROYED/exact owner+jail+cgroup absent/all fixed quota records zero, original key410. Fresh real KVM/unprivileged guest/exec/destroy proves capacity and private slot reuse.
clear_failure_checks: Armed errno policy remains enabled until observations complete: durable RECLAIMING with StoppedAt but no DestroyedAt, exact original attempted owner bytes retained, execution namespace already absent, new Create503. Then disarm and ordinary cleanup must reach durable DESTROYED/owner absent/key410/quota zero before fresh real KVM/exec/destroy. One injection per clear case was observed; repeated retry was not required or claimed.

independent_cleanup.boundary_and_quota_proof: Actual own-L1 observations before disk deletion, not inferred from the final path audit.
